metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: panes, bands and hooks written as plugins of function hooks.

plugins.name: crab-crew
plugins.description: A crew panel for standard subagents (/ms-crab-crew): each agent type is a crab character with its own role, look and lines, animated by its status and progress.

plugins.name: crew-dispatch
plugins.description: A dispatch board (/ms-crew-dispatch) that routes subagents to a model and an effort by agent type, from a table you set in /config or on the board, and lists what each subagent of the session ran on and why.

plugins.name: obsidian-cli-mcp-tool-stats
plugins.description: Usage stats for the obsidian-cli-mcp server (/ms-obsidian-cli-mcp-tool-stats): calls, estimated tokens, errors and latency per tool, with hints on heavy results, repeat calls, error patterns and unused schemas, kept across sessions.

plugins.name: review-desk
plugins.description: A review desk panel (/ms-review-desk): Claude publishes open questions, decisions, findings, write plans, animated explainers and read-throughs; you answer, ask and submit in the panel, and the outcome goes back to Claude.

plugins.name: session-lens
plugins.description: A session lens pane (/ms-session-lens): how full the context window is, Claude's to-do list, its crew of subagents as animated crabs with a progress band above the prompt, and the skills and tools this session used, each section folding on its own. Replaces crab-crew: disable or don't install crab-crew alongside it.
